crossRefs.note: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to…
Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in…
Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you…
This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman…
But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, and of the fat calves, and the lambs…
The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all…
They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey…
Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

people.name: Nob
people.line: A city of priests near Jerusalem

translations.web: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle and donkeys and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
translations.bsb: He also put to the sword Nob, the city of the priests, with its men and women, children and infants, oxen, donkeys, and sheep.
translations.kjv: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
translations.asv: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen and asses and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
